question: What Are the Main DCS Communication Protocols?
body_html:
DCS communication protocols are the common languages that let field instruments, controllers and operator stations exchange process values, alarms and diagnostics.

ProtocolHow it worksTypical use
HARTDigital FSK signal on the 4 to 20 mA loopSmart transmitters, valve positioners
ModbusMaster slave; RTU on RS-485, TCP/IP on EthernetEnergy meters, VFDs, remote I/O
ProfibusDP for fast remote I/O, PA for process devicesChemical and oil and gas plants
FOUNDATION FieldbusAll digital bus for field devicesLarge process plants

Profibus PA also suits hazardous areas.
